caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a metal oil lamp with a hanging mechanism. The lamp has a rounded, flat-bottomed base with a protruding spout on one side, from which a thin element extends. Attached to the top of the lamp is an arched handle, which connects to a twisted vertical rod. This rod is equipped with several loops and hooks, forming a chain-like structure that suggests adjustability in its hanging position. The topmost part of the rod terminates in a pointed end with a perpendicular hook, likely designed to hang the entire object from a surface. The image is rendered in grayscale, with shading used to convey the metallic texture and three-dimensional form of the object. The background is plain, unadorned, and light-colored, providing contrast and focus to the central object.
title: Betty Lamp
